title: SmartSubs Pro v2.9.15
notes: Fixes and improvements. The live preview in Resolve's viewer now shows the sample caption even at the very start of the timeline, and works correctly on 29.97 and 59.94 drop-frame timelines. Captions can no longer be dragged partly outside the frame, and a caption placed at the left or bottom edge is now added exactly where the preview shows it. Closing the preview now leaves your caption tracks on every timeline exactly as you set them. Automatic emoji no longer appear on unrelated words, and symbols you type in a correction (such as → or ✓) are kept. Security updates for the speech engine.
